description: Criteo OneTag dynamic loader on dynamic.criteo.com and static.criteo.net, whose partner ID rides as query parameter a.

params.name: a
params.description: It is the numeric Criteo Partner ID. Criteo documents the loader as `ld.js?a=` plus that ID.
params.fix_hint: Set `a` to the Partner ID Criteo issued for the OneTag.
